purpose: Cover every acceptance criterion of US-18901 with one node:test case each in test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js; DEFINE lands the named declarations flagged not yet built so the strict coverage audit binds each criterion, and BUILD (FBS-211) removes the flags as it makes them pass.
title: US-18901 UX intake gate suite (journey-declare)

testCases.description: [happy] Given an intake run carrying --ui with a value from [none | light | central], when intake writes the intakeClassification, then rcf/discovery/journey.json exists with JourneyRecord.ui equal to the declared value, JourneyRecord.declaredVia equal to "intake" and JourneyRecord.declaredAt equal to the run time.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-1 happy: an intake run carrying ui with a value from none

testCases.description: [happy] Given an existing journey.json, when the operator runs the journey declare verb with --ui and a new value, then JourneyRecord.ui is replaced and JourneyRecord.declaredVia equals "declare", and lowering the value (central to light, or light or central to none) without --reason is refused with exit 2 naming the flag while the same call with --reason records the reason on the record.

[happy] Given an interactive intake run with no --ui flag, when the artefact text carries UI signals from the shared matcher, then intake prints the signals and the proposed value and asks for the declaration, and the value written is the one the operator typed, never the proposal.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-3 happy: an interactive intake run with no ui flag

testCases.description: [failure] Given a non-interactive intake run through --input with no ui field, when the artefact text carries UI signals from the shared matcher, then intake exits 2 naming the ui field and writes neither the intakeClassification nor journey.json.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-4 failure: a noninteractive intake run through input with n

testCases.description: [edge] Given a tree with no rcf/discovery/journey.json, when readiness computes D0, then D0 reports notApplicable with the reason "no discovery declaration (existing tree)", the door check passes, and no verb writes journey.json on the tree's behalf.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-5 edge: a tree with no rcfdiscoveryjourneyjson

testCases.description: [edge] Given rcf init on this version, when the tree is created, then rcf/discovery/journey.json is written with JourneyRecord.ui null and JourneyRecord.declaredVia "init", and D0 reports failing on discovery:declared until a declaration is made.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-6 edge: rcf init on this version

testCases.description: [must-not] Given a tree with no journey.json, when rcf doctor runs with or without --fix, then the missing declaration appears under notices as advice and never under drift, the exit code is unchanged by it, and --fix never writes the record.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-7 must-not: a tree with no journeyjson
